Basic duct CO2 version reads 0xC100. | bit 0-1 = T: type (0 duct, 1 room); bit 2-3 = Always 0; bit 4-8 = OPTIONS: device type (b10000 = CO2 transducer with MH-Z19B); bit 9-10 = HV: hardware version; bit 11-15 = DEV: b11000 = air parameter sensor
Four nibbles N.AB + revision letter, e.g. 0x3210 = 3.21a. | bit 0-3 = REV: revision letter (0 = a ... 9 = j); bit 4-7 = B digit; bit 8-11 = A digit; bit 12-15 = N digit
